channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Africa, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Africa, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

• Gallery 1957: Yaa Asantewaa Art Prize 2026
    https://www.gallery1957.com/the-yaa-asantewaa-art-prize/
    Gallery 1957 · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 5,000 cash per winner, two winners (one Ghanaian, one Senegalese), plus a fully covered three-month residency exchange: flights, transportation of artworks, accommodation and materials. No application fee.
